builds.title: Krugel Orc outrider, level 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 race-as-class. 0 XP, next level at 1,000 XP.
builds.speed: 120 ft. (40 ft. per encounter round) on foot
traits: Neutral. 7 rolled hp plus 1 from Constitution. Leather AC 7. He keeps his on-foot load within 400 cn. Strength grants a 5% advancement XP bonus.
THAC0 19 before attack modifiers. Saves in order (death ray/poison, wands, paralysis/stone, dragon breath, rods/staves/spells) 12/13/14/15/16.
Standard side initiative each 10-second round, 1d6 per side, high roll first and ties simultaneous. The initiative value shown is unused with side initiative. Morale 8.
actions: Thrust a spear one-handed, +1 on the attack roll, for 1d6+1 damage.
Throw the spear, +0 before range adjustments, for 1d6+1 damage. Range bands 20/40/60, with +1/0/−1 to hit respectively. Use feet indoors or yards outdoors.
builds.tactics: Khar stays close to the well. He keeps the spear in hand until a retreat is clear and breaks off pursuit if strangers move toward the water.

builds.title: Malpheggi Lizardman ferry scout, level 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 race-as-class. 0 XP, next level at 1,500 XP.
builds.speed: Land 90 ft. (30 ft. per encounter round), swim 120 ft. (40 ft. per encounter round)
traits: Neutral. 7 rolled hp plus 1 from Constitution. Natural AC 5, no shield. Breathes water indefinitely. Strength grants a 5% advancement XP bonus.
THAC0 19 before attack modifiers. Saves in order (death ray/poison, wands, paralysis/stone, dragon breath, rods/staves/spells) 11/12/14/16/15.
Standard side initiative each 10-second round, 1d6 per side, high roll first and ties simultaneous. The initiative value shown is unused with side initiative. Morale 8.
actions: Thrust a spear one-handed, +1 on the attack roll, for 1d6+1 damage.
With hands empty, strike with two claws. Roll each attack separately at +1, for 1d4+1 damage per hit.
builds.tactics: Sseth slips underwater when threatened and uses the reeds to cut off sight. He fights with the spear while he can keep an escape channel open.

builds.title: Kogolor Dwarf trail guide, level 1
builds.difficulty: Level 1 Dwarf race-as-class. 0 XP, next level at 2,200 XP.
traits: Lawful. 6 rolled hp plus 1 from Constitution. Scale mail AC 6, improved by 1 with shield. Scale mail, shield and cane weigh 450 cn together. His total load stays within 800 cn. Strength grants a 5% advancement XP bonus.
THAC0 19 before attack modifiers. Saves in order (death ray/poison, wands, paralysis/stone, dragon breath, rods/staves/spells) 8/9/10/13/12.
Standard side initiative each 10-second round, 1d6 per side, high roll first and ties simultaneous. The initiative value shown is unused with side initiative. Morale 8.
actions: Strike with walking cane as a club, +1 on the attack roll, for 1d4+1 damage.
Search once for each suspected trap in stonework, sliding wall, sloping passage or new construction. Find it on 1–2 on a d6 if present.
builds.tactics: Korin uses the shield to buy time for travelers to move uphill. He knows where the damaged wall will not support a fight.

builds.title: Gully Dwarf tunnel scavenger, Rogue 1
traits: Neutral. BAB +0, grapple −4, touch AC 14, flat-footed AC 13. Fort +2 (+4 against poison or disease), Ref +5, Will +1 (−3 against fear). Also takes −4 on level checks against Intimidate.
Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3 and Small size +1. No armor check penalty. Improved Initiative adds +4 to Dexterity +3. Max first Hit Die plus Constitution gives 8 hp. Carries a light load.

Trapfinding allows Search for difficult and magical traps, plus Disable Device on magical traps. Skill ranks, 4 each in Disable Device, Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Open Lock, Search and Spot. He may use Survival to forage in cities.
actions: Small club +1 melee, 1d4 bludgeoning, critical ×2. Small sling +4 ranged, 1d3 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 50-ft. range increment.
Sneak attack adds 1d6 when the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC or Nib flanks it. Ranged sneak attack also requires a target within 30 ft.
builds.tactics: Nib hides when he hears unfamiliar steps. He talks first if spotted, fights from cover if cornered and leaves by the smallest open passage.

concepts.name: Khar Amberrein
concepts.role: Mercenary outrider stationed at a well.
concepts.motive: Find the two stable hands who disappeared with a string of borrowed ponies.
concepts.hook: Khar offers water and safe passage if the party checks whether his missing ponies made it across a dry riverbed.

concepts.name: Sseth Reedwake
concepts.motive: Find who moved the reed markers before another boat grounds in the nursery shallows.
concepts.hook: Sseth surfaces beside a stranded skiff and offers to tow it free in exchange for help tracking a second boat.

concepts.name: Korin Switchback
concepts.motive: Warn the next outpost that a retaining wall cracked below a busy switchback.
concepts.hook: Korin sends a warning down the ridge in yodel. When the answer comes from a different slope than expected, he asks the party to check the watch post.

concepts.name: Nib Patchfoot
concepts.motive: Recover the gate latch before the next flood reaches his sleeping spot.
concepts.hook: Nib recognizes the brass fitting the party found upstairs. He offers a route below the sealed cellar if they let him put it back.
